text: You kick the crown-door. For one glorious second, boldness seems like a complete strategy, and then the flame answers with the patience of something old enough to enjoy consequences.

{{companion:Liora shouts your name with the exact tone that means this will be discussed if you live.|Bram follows the kick with his shoulder, because if foolishness has momentum he refuses to waste it.|Knox dives sideways and says, "I would like the record to show I advised elegance."}}

nodes.label: Lord Malrec
text: Malrec stands before the throne, gray-eyed and smiling. The Ember Crown 👑 floats above him, dripping black sparks upward.

{{companion:Liora looks at Malrec and sees not a monster first, but a wound that learned to command others to hurt with it.|Bram looks at Malrec and sees every gate left unguarded, every oath turned into a weapon.|Knox looks at Malrec and sees a thief who stole something too hungry to fence.}}
"Asterfall needs a ruler brave enough to be feared," Malrec says. "Will that be me, or you?"

nodes.label: Crown Broken
text: You break the Ember Crown against the throne stair. Its fire rushes outward 🔥, melting summer back into the mountains.

{{companion:Liora gathers the last harmless embers in a bowl and says grief can be warm without becoming a throne.|Bram plants his hammer where the crown fell and stands guard until dawn, though there is nothing left to guard but choice.|Knox pockets one cold, powerless fragment, not to sell, he says, but to remember the lock that finally stayed broken.}}
Asterfall loses its oldest magic, but the people who survive will decide what replaces it.

nodes.label: New Monarch
text: You claim the Ember Crown. 👑 It burns, then bends, accepting your will with a hunger that feels almost like loyalty.

{{companion:Liora does not kneel at first. When she does, it is with tears in her eyes and one warning you can still choose to hear.|Bram kneels like a guard swearing to the person, not the crown, and the difference matters more than court songs will admit.|Knox bows beautifully, then looks up with the expression of a man counting exits from a throne room.}}
Asterfall kneels to a new ruler. Whether that ruler stays merciful is a story for colder nights.

nodes.label: Mercy Flame
text: You lower your weapon and speak Malrec's name without hatred. The crown's black sparks falter, confused by mercy it cannot command.

{{companion:Liora steps beside you and makes mercy feel less like surrender than surgery.|Bram keeps his hammer ready until the chains close, proving mercy does not require foolish hands.|Knox unlocks Malrec's hidden dagger before anyone sees it, then says forgiveness is improved by inventory control.}}
By dawn, the throne room is warm, Malrec is in chains, and Asterfall has a chance to heal without forgetting.

nodes.label: Final Duel
text: Malrec draws a blade from the crown's shadow. It is not metal, not magic, but the shape of every promise he broke, sharpened by all the people who believed him too late.

{{companion:Liora says no wound justifies becoming a knife.|Bram moves with you, matching Malrec's first step before the duel even begins.|Knox watches Malrec's off hand, because honest duelists are rare and villains are predictable in their vanity.}}

nodes.label: Shadow Vow
text: You kneel and accept the crown's shadow. Malrec laughs once before it consumes him too.

{{companion:Liora backs away with one hand over her mouth, already mourning the person still wearing your face.|Bram refuses to kneel until the shadow forces the room cold enough to crack his hammer haft.|Knox smiles because survival demands it, but his eyes keep measuring the distance to the nearest window.}}
The winter stops at Asterfall's borders, but inside them every hearth now burns with a listening black flame.

nodes.label: Malrec Falls
text: You beat Malrec back step by step until his shadow blade cracks. The crown hangs above you, waiting for your judgment, and for the first time Malrec looks less like a lord than a man who has run out of borrowed fire.

{{companion:Liora says, "End the crown, not yourself with it."|Bram stands over Malrec and does not strike again, which may be his bravest blow.|Knox kicks the broken shadow blade away and says nobody gets to steal the ending twice.}}

nodes.label: Last Wound
text: Malrec's blade opens a cold line across your chest. You drop to one knee, close enough to see fear reach his eyes, and close enough to understand that even now he thinks the crown will save him first.

{{companion:Liora is already moving, furious with the wound and the man who made it.|Bram bellows your name so loudly the throne room seems to flinch.|Knox throws every hidden knife he has left, not to win, only to buy the breath after this one.}}

nodes.label: Disarmed
text: Your weapon skids across the floor. Malrec advances, and the Ember Crown dips low enough to touch, offering itself with the intimate warmth of a hand that has pushed many people over many edges.

{{companion:Liora shouts for you not to answer pain with hunger.|Bram lunges for your weapon, but shadow chains catch his boots for one terrible second.|Knox sees the crown lower and whispers, "That is not an opening. That is bait."}}

nodes.label: Shard Mercy
text: You crush the last shards in your palm. Their fire floods the room, not as a weapon, but as memory of what the crown once guarded: hearths, harvests, children asleep without frost on their lashes.

{{companion:Liora catches your bleeding hand and refuses to let sacrifice become theater.|Bram shields you from Malrec's final strike with his own shoulder.|Knox sweeps the shards toward the throne-circle exactly where the old lock needs them.}}

nodes.label: Ally's Stand
text: {{companion:Liora steps between you and Malrec with a healer's knife and a voice that makes even the crown hesitate. "No more," she says.|Bram takes Malrec's shadow blade across his hammer haft and holds, boots sliding, grin fierce through pain.|Knox flicks a stolen clasp from Malrec's cloak into the crown's flame, spoiling the spell with one beautifully petty theft.}}
It is one impossible heartbeat. It is enough. You rise and choose the crown's end.

nodes.label: Brazier Spark
text: Your kick topples the brazier into the crown's shadow. Flame turns black, then bows toward the power that was waiting underneath, eager to be mistaken for rescue.

{{companion:Liora reaches for you and stops, because some thresholds cannot be healed from the outside.|Bram roars a warning that arrives one heartbeat too late.|Knox's face goes very still, the smile gone, all exits suddenly too far away.}}
